hypothesis: Continuous weekly-claims dynamics can improve the next unpublished weekly claims release versus last available value and 4-week average.
target: first ALFRED value of next Saturday week; nowcast of unpublished release, not future layoffs
issue: Wednesday, cut preceding Tuesday; reject labels with first-available date <= issue day
model: ridge conditional mean of next first-release log change; train-only scaling, mean-loss penalty1, unpenalized intercept
train: last156calendarweeks; minimum104origins with label available by cut; freeze features/base at historical origin
comparison: paired RMS log error and mean absolute log error vs persistence and4weekmean
acceptance: RMS log error at least5percent lower than BOTH comparators; separate future experiment required
retuning: none; no hyperparameter search, keep pandemic and missing exclusions
